observations: Photo shows two cylindrical/rounded power-bank style battery packs (no clear brand/model visible).
One pack has a taped/covered section on its surface (looks like repair/covering or protective wrap).
Multiple blue cables are connected/lying around the packs; ports/labels are not readable.
No visible capacity rating (mAh), voltage, or charging output specs on the photo.

claims.claim: Scrap power banks for sale in Ibadan.
claims.evidence: Location/market claim not shown in the photo.
Photo shows taped/covered area on one unit, which contradicts 'new' appearance; no date/receipt/label visible.
No test meter, runtime test video, or load/usage details shown.
Taped/covered section on one pack suggests possible repair or at least covering; cannot confirm.

risks.risk: Capacity may be low or degraded; '8 hours' depends on load and battery health.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing a full charge, then powering a clearly identified load (e.g., phone model + screen-on brightness) with a timer until shutdown.
risks.if_unproven: Price as scrap/unknown capacity (worst case: not reliable runtime).

risks.risk: Taped/covered area may indicate prior damage, swelling, or unsafe cells.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the taped area and any seams/ports, plus a photo of the inside if safely accessible (or at least a clear inspection of the casing).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/unsafe for normal use.

risks.risk: Charging/output specs (voltage/current, USB output) are unknown; may not charge phones properly.
risks.proof: Ask for a multimeter reading of output voltage/current under load and a photo of any label/specs (mAh, input/output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to charge devices correctly.

risks.risk: Quantity/condition mismatch: photo shows two units, but seller may be selling more or different condition.
risks.proof: Ask for the exact number of units included and a photo of each unit (front/back/ports).
risks.if_unproven: Price based on the worst-case assumption that only the shown units are usable and condition is mixed.

proof_requests: Video proof of runtime: show full charge, then power a specific load (phone model + screen-on) with a timer until it stops.
Close-up photos of the taped/covered section(s) and ports (front/back), plus any label showing mAh and input/output ratings.
Multimeter test: output voltage/current while charging a phone (or a dummy load) and charging input voltage/current.
Confirm exact quantity of power banks included and show each one clearly.
response.reason: The photos do not show brand/model, capacity (mAh), or any test results, and the seller’s key claims (new, 8-hour runtime, never repaired) are not verifiable from the single image—especially with visible tape/covering that may indicate prior damage.
